column1: # Squad Six: the squad limit (MaxSquadSize) for every mission definition in the game.
# game     MaxSquadSize the game ships ("default" = not serialized; the class default is 1).
#          tools/build_core.py fails if the game's value has changed, so a patch can't slip by.
# squad    the value Squad Six ships. Rows where it differs from game go into the Core pak.
# note     why a mission is not raised to 6
# The runtime (limits.lua) also writes 6 to any loaded mission still at 4, except the ones it guards
# (GUARDED_MISSION_NAMES, SCRIPTED_COMPANION_MISSION_NAMES), so keep those lists in step with this file.
